settings.fullTrailNote: Showing the full flight trail may seriously affect performance on long logs.

help.headingText: Shows a red line from the aircraft in the direction of its current yaw / heading (the way the nose is pointed).
help.targetText: Shows an orange line in the navigation bearing / target direction — the path the autopilot is trying to follow toward the active setpoint.
help.windText: Shows a dark green line with an arrow for estimated wind direction. Line length scales with wind speed when that data is available in the log.
help.trailColorsText: The trail behind the aircraft is colored by ArduPlane flight mode (HEARTBEAT customMode). Larger dots mark the moments when flight mode changes.

summary.sticksNote: Average stick deflection from center PWM 1500 (±500 full travel), counted only in manual / stick modes (MANUAL, STABILIZE, TRAINING, ACRO, FBWA, FBWB, CRUISE, AUTOTUNE, QSTABILIZE, QHOVER).
summary.stickNoData: No RC stick data in manual modes for this flight.
summary.imuNote: Based on ArduPilot guidance: vibe <30 m/s² OK, 30–60 caution, >60 severe; clip counters ideally 0 (<100 often OK); accel peaks vs ~16 g IMU limit; gyro peak rates.
summary.imuLegendHealthy: Vibe <30 m/s² · clip Δ 0 · accel <4 g · gyro <5 rad/s
summary.imuLegendWarn: Vibe 30–60 · clip Δ <100 · accel 4–8 g · gyro 5–15 rad/s
summary.imuLegendBad: Vibe >60 · clip Δ ≥100 · accel ≥8 g · gyro ≥15 rad/s

overall.Warn: IMU has warnings — review vibration / clipping / rates
overall.Bad: IMU issues detected — check vibration isolation / hardware

accel.Healthy: Acceleration peaks within normal flight range
accel.Warn: High acceleration peaks — check maneuvers / mounting
accel.Bad: Very high acceleration — near IMU saturation risk

gyro.Healthy: Gyro rates within normal flight range
gyro.Warn: Elevated gyro rates — check aggressive flight / vibration
gyro.Bad: Extreme gyro rates — verify IMU / airframe integrity

vibe.Warn: Elevated vibration — may affect position / altitude hold
vibe.Bad: Severe vibration — position / altitude hold problems likely
